todayOrders.title: Executive Order 12332—Establishment of the National Productivity Advisory Committee
todayOrders.tone_tag: Art. I §8: Delegated Tariff & Commerce Execution
todayOrders.snippet: There is established the National Productivity Advisory Committee. The Committee shall be composed of distinguished citizens appointed by the President, only one of whom may be a full-time officer or employee of the Federal Government.

todayOrders.title: Executive Order 10975—Creating an Emergency Board to Investigate a Dispute Between Pan American World Airways, Inc., and Certain of its Employees
todayOrders.tone_tag: Art. II §1: Executive Discretion & Internal Operations
todayOrders.snippet: I hereby create a board of three members, to be appointed by me, to investigate this dispute. No member of the board shall be pecuniarily or otherwise interested in any organization of airline employees or any carrier.
